这个年纪能有这个分寸，何向东不得不承认——总部是会选人的。

气氛缓和下来后，顾承安又抛出了一句不相干的话。

“对了何局长，江绍庭副局长的办公室在哪？我等会儿想去拜访一下，打个照面。”

何向东愣了一瞬。

然后开口道。

“老江在十七楼，1703。”

顾承安点头，道了声谢。

随后两人又闲聊了一会儿，顾承安感觉差不多了，遂起身告辞。

何向东挽留了下，见顾承安去意已决，刚好他也挺忙的，也就没再坚持，就起身送到了门口，并招呼李秘书送一送。

何向东回到办公椅上坐下，沉思起来。

好一会儿，他拿起桌上的内线电话。

“小张，帮我查一下，最近一个月老江的日程安排表，注意保密。”

电话那头：“好的，何局。”

何向东挂了电话，往椅子上靠了靠，视线落在窗外远处的城市天际线上。

市局层面——苏楠的案子——拜访江绍庭。

三件事串在一起，可能真相已经不需要说出口了。

何向东叹了口气，自言自语了一句。

“这鹏城的水，怕是要搅一搅咯。”

电梯门打开，顾承安冲李秘书摆了摆手。

“留步，李秘书。”

“那顾专员您慢走！”

然后退了半步，电梯门关拢。

“叮”一声，十七楼到了。

电梯门打开，顾承安一眼就看见走廊中段摆了张小桌子，后面坐着个年轻人，二十五六岁的样子，寸头。

对方也看见了他。

顾承安迈步走过去，裤兜里手机震了一下。

他没去看。

年轻人已经站了起来，目光在顾承安身上扫了一圈——很陌生，但气质不像来办事的“群众”。

“您好，请问您找谁？”

顾承安偏头看了一眼旁边的门牌：1703，副局长办公室。

Being able to have such sense at this age, He Xiangdong had to admit that the headquarters would choose people.

After the atmosphere calmed down, Gu Chengan made another irrelevant comment.

"By the way, Director He, where is Deputy Director Jiang Shaoting's office? I want to visit him later and have a face-to-face meeting."

He Xiangdong was stunned for a moment.

Then he spoke.

"Lao Jiang is on the seventeenth floor, 1703."

Gu Chengan nodded and thanked him.

Then the two chatted for a while, and Gu Chengan felt that it was almost done, so he stood up and left.

He Xiangdong persuaded him to stay. Seeing that Gu Chengan had decided to go and he happened to be quite busy, he didn't insist anymore, got up and walked to the door, and asked Secretary Li to see him off.

He Xiangdong returned to his office chair and sat down, thinking deeply.

After a while, he picked up the intercom phone on the table.

"Xiao Zhang, help me check Lao Jiang's schedule for the past month. Please keep it confidential."

On the other end of the phone: "Okay, what's the situation?"

He Xiangdong hung up the phone, leaned back in his chair, and looked at the city skyline in the distance outside the window.

At the municipal bureau level - Su Nan's case - visit Jiang Shaoting.

With these three things put together, the truth may no longer need to be told.

He Xiangdong sighed and muttered to himself.

"I'm afraid the water in Peng City will be disturbed."

The elevator door opened and Gu Chengan waved to Secretary Li.

"Stay, Secretary Li."

"Commissioner Gu, please walk slowly!"

Then he took half a step back and the elevator door closed.

"Ding", the seventeenth floor has arrived.

When the elevator door opened, Gu Chengan immediately saw a small table set up in the middle of the corridor. Sitting behind it was a young man, who looked to be in his mid-twenties and had a short hair.

The other party also saw him.

Gu Chengan walked over and his phone vibrated in his trouser pocket.

He didn't look.

The young man had already stood up and glanced around Gu Chengan - he was very strange, but his temperament did not look like the "people" who came to do business.

"Hello, who are you looking for?"

Gu Chengan turned his head and glanced at the door number next to him: 1703, Deputy Director's Office.
